responsibility: Provides small shared constructors for commonly-used integer value ranges in GCC’s range subsystem. It centralizes helpers that create zero, nonzero, positive, and negative value_range objects from a tree type, giving VRP and ranger code a consistent way to build these canonical range facts without embedding the bounds logic at each call site.
same_name_distinction: Implements only the small constructor helpers for common canonical ranges such as zero, nonzero, positive, and negative; unlike gcc/range-op.cc it does not model expression operators, and unlike gcc/range.h it supplies the out-of-line definitions for those helper builders.
